column1: What were the reasons for the patient's ineligibility? Select all that apply.
Not capable of making decisions with respect to health
Not in an advanced state of irreversible decline in capability
Not experiencing suffering that is intolerable to them
Did not have a serious and incurable illness, disease or disability

Explanatory Notes: This chart represents MAID data where the report was received by Health Canada by January 31, 2021. For 2020, this represents 9,375 written MAID requests including 566 individuals deemed ineligible for MAID. Since practitioners could determine that an individual did not meet more than one of these criteria, the total responses exceed 100%.
